notes: ἀπέναντι is classified improper under rule 95 (one case, no verbal compound), so rule 71 settles its complex frame — including the trailing *of* — whole on the adverb and heads it on *presence*.

ἡ δι᾽ αὐτοῦ follows its noun, so under rule 31 the article keeps only *which* and the copula goes with the preposition; ἐστερέωσεν → *made … strong* heads on *strong* under rule 91, matching 3:7's *received strength*.
